value: Decided a segmented LRU (probation and protected segments, protected capped at 80%) because a gallery scan touches thousands of thumbnails once and must only churn probation. Rejected: plain LRU — one scan evicts the whole working set; LFU — stale popular entries never leave and counters cost 16 bytes per entry. Applies to `SegmentedLru`, src/cache/segmented_lru.py.

thumb_cache_bytes stays at 512 MiB unless the container memory limit rises with it, because the renderer needs 1 GiB of headroom and a larger cache under the same limit gets the process killed. Applies to src/cache/config.py.

Decided exponential backoff with full jitter (200 ms start, 30 s cap, at most 5 attempts) because jitter spreads many clients' retries after a gateway restart. Rejected: fixed-interval retries — every client retries in the same second and the gateway falls over again. Applies to `RetryPolicy`, src/upload/retry.py.
Every upload attempt carries the same idempotency key, because a retry after a lost response must never store the original twice. Applies to src/upload/client.py.
Only 5xx responses and timeouts are retried; a 429 is reported to the caller, never retried. Applies to src/upload/retry.py.

value: Decided to retry 5xx responses, timeouts and 429 responses, a 429 after the delay its Retry-After header asks for, because the gateway sheds load with 429 during deploys and those uploads succeed seconds later. Applies to src/upload/retry.py.
